programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Air: Changing the Atmosphere"
programme.desc: Every year seven million people die from air pollution. It's the world's biggest environmental killer.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Food"
programme.desc: In South Africa and Nepal, earthrise looks at food production solutions being developed to help with adjusting to new conditions.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Shelter"
programme.desc: In Colombia and Singapore, earthrise looks at sustainable forms of shelter.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Land Gaining Ground"
programme.desc: Earthrise looks at methods of land restoration and conservation as human causes and climate change wreak havoc.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Survival"
programme.desc: As the US no longer stands to be a global climate leader, China takes the mantle.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Antarctica On The Edge"
programme.desc: Earthrise sets off on a month-long journey around Antarctica to study the effects of climate change on the continent.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"
programme.desc: Earthrise assesses the depth of the crisis facing the world’s grasslands today, and explores some of the solutions that are being used to preserve them.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Astronauts"
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Shore to Shore"
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA on Mars.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Declaring Martian Law"
programme.desc: Space is home to crucial resources, important discoveries, and big potential profit.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 1)"
programme.desc: We take you behind the scenes for an exclusive look at the inner workings of one of America’s biggest air shows.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )"
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to the two-part special including an up-close look at the U.S. Navy Blue Angels.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programme.desc: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive flyer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programme.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programme.desc: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft ownership"
programme.desc: Kurtis explores the varied costs and entry points of flying for everyone from the weekend warrior to the rich and famous. When your driveway is a runway, life is good… and as airparks go, this place is Heavenly! Are two engines really better than one?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programme.desc: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programme.desc: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Wind"
programme.desc: This film follows the race to generate vast power from thin air - the wind. One of the world's biggest windfarms is being built off the English coast.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Aviation"
programme.desc: The way we fly about to change, driven by a new breed of aviators not afraid to think differently. Could the days of the jet age be numbered?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programme.desc: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"
programme.desc: The power of the ocean's tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth. Teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flowers of water.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Maritime"
programme.desc: Shipping companies and engineers are creating new machines to make their industry greener using a resource that has moved man across oceans for thousands of years... winds.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Solar"
programme.desc: The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system. Innovators are searching for new ways to capture more of the sun's power.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Venice"
programme.desc: Engineers strip away the waters of Venice to reveal how ancient wooden piles and modern sea barriers protect the historic city from sinking.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programme.desc: The layers of America's largest metropolis are peeled back to show how skyscrapers withstand high winds and subways navigate a subterranean labyrinth.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Chicago"
programme.desc: CGI animation strips down the Windy City, uncovering the deep foundations and structural engineering required to build on unstable marshland.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Experts strip away Tokyo to show the seismic engineering, massive storm drains, and advanced shock absorbers keeping this earthquake-prone city safe.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: The defenses of New Orleans are stripped back to expose the massive pumps, levees, and wetlands engineered to hold back Mississippi and Gulf storms.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Paris"
programme.desc: Using a virtual scalpel, CGI strips the Eiffel Tower to its 17-foot base and peels back the boulevards to expose 180 miles of ancient quarries.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: CGI animation dismantles this ancient mountain city, uncovering the genius Incan terraces, drainage systems, and stonework that survive seismic shifts

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Los Angeles is stripped to its bones, revealing the high-tech base isolators, fault-line monitoring, and infrastructure built to survive the Big One.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Terry's Criminal Mind"
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Shark Go Boom!"
programme.desc: Here, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a shark on a platform to test if you can hit the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "The Good the Bad and Terry"
programme.desc: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood – aka “Blondie” – saves Eli Wallach from the hangman’s noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Dying Hard"
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Runway Race"
programme.desc: A family in St Cloud, Minnesota call in a team of house movers to move a beautiful two-storey home, destined to be their son’s first home, to rescue it from the wrecking ball.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Colossal Cabin"
programme.desc: A family in Greenville, Florida calls in a team of house haulers to move their much-loved holiday log cabin along a treacherous route to a new site.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Risky Rescue"
programme.desc: A family in Silex, Missouri call in a team of heavy haulers to rescue their treasured home from a waterlogged flood plain.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Historic House"
programme.desc: A family in Calgary call in a team of house truckers to move a historic colonial house to help give them – and their five children – more living space.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Animal Rescue"
programme.desc: In this episode, we will visit a few different animal rescues centers starting with the marine mammal centre in Vancouver as they tend to orphaned harbor seals.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Invasive Planet"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few different ways researchers are fighting invasive plants, animals, and materials in native habitats.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Power of Water"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll see ways that water is the backbone of energy and resources in different areas across the planet.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Teens Making An Impact"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet teens that are working to make the planet a better place with innovative ideas and lots of hard work.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Pursuit of Happiness Part 2"
programme.desc: Mike learns what happiness means to the people of Bhutan. He visits a school and a rural farm and learns how happiness is integrated into day-to-day life and leaves a note for his father at the famous Tigers Nest temple.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Forest Bathing"
programme.desc: Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition of forest bathing offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Purpose of Life Part 1"
programme.desc: We learn about Ikigai and the reason for being that is so fundamental for life in Okinawa. We visit gardeners, play gate ball and meet an elder who is heralded for her wellness in the famous Miss Kitanakagusku contest.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Purpose of Life Part 2"
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked using your ears, nose and tongue? We learn about the ancient practice of Shin Rin Yoku or Forest Bathing on the outskirts of the worlds largest city.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award 21st - Part 2"
programme.desc: Watch the second part of a feature on the second award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Logistic 4.0"
programme.desc: Follow the parcel worldwide delivery technology.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 1"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 2"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Chainsaws, Jukeboxes, and Fishing Reels"
programme.desc: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Escalators, Leaf Blowers, and Music Boxes"
programme.desc: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Lawnmowers, Pinball Machines and Padlocks"
programme.desc: Lawn mower, pinball machine, padlock, watch, toilet, yo-yo... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Refrigerators, Electric Guitars and Garden Sprinklers"
programme.desc: Ticket barrier, refrigerator, electric guitar, grass trimmer, garden sprinkler and movie camera lens... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programme.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV"
programme.desc: Developed from solidified vegetable oil, this military grade compound is a long way from department store concealer: it’s sweat proof, infrared resistant, and stays on in the drenching downpour. For soldiers, especially Special Ops and snipers, camo paint completes their covert coverage.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Roads That Changed The World"
programme.desc: Chariots were the express vehicles of their day – but how did they work? And what about the roads, tunnels, and bridges that they relied upon?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coup In Crimea"
programme.desc: The Crimea Annexation in February 2014 was the biggest and most blatant land grab in Europe since WWII and shook the very foundations upon which peace in the region had been based ever since. How did Russia execute the annexation?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Yemen Britain & The Saudis"
programme.desc: In March 2019 news reports appeared in the British press of UK’s troops being killed in Yemen, no one knew why they are there in the first place. Britain was not fighting a war in Yemen. This episode investigates the truth behind the casualties.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.
